title: 1 攻略系统，阿茜娜
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

胃袋像是被攥成了一团，五脏六腑翻江倒海。

“呕……呕！”

痛苦的呕吐声，盥洗室狭小老旧，脱落的墙皮堆在角落里，水龙头被拧开。

水声哗哗，碎了一角的镜子里倒映出一张纤细苍白的脸。

雪白长卷发直披到腰际，睫毛也雪白，像一场皑皑细雪，眼睛是一种极其浅淡的紫色，几乎像是粉色。

她看起来狼狈不堪，穿着陈旧的绿裙子，眉头痛苦地皱在一起，长久被病痛折磨，脸色苍白憔悴，可又是那么美那么美。

像美神亲手投向此世的一只蝴蝶。

时间于此停止流动凝固成琥珀，为这份绝世的美丽而屏息敛容。

镜子里的女孩儿笑了一下，嘴角翘起来。

时间重新开始流动。

周珈蓝用手沾水，先洗脸，再匆匆梳拢那头长长的白发。

她手指线条纤细得像花瓣，透过薄薄皮肤能看清血管的颜色，像花瓣上缠绕的经脉。

窗外大屏幕上在放映周泽楷的最新代言广告，年轻男孩子长着一张好看到无可挑剔的脸，高高瘦瘦，侧脸线条漂亮到锋利，是时下女孩儿愿意为之尖叫的好模样。

周珈蓝认识他，活在这个时代你很难不认识周泽楷，这个名字简直是热度和商业价值的形容词。

全民游戏荣耀顶级职业选手，最高热度职业比赛gpl全明星选手，俱乐部是S市轮回，职业是神枪手，账号卡是一枪穿云，武器是荒火和碎霜……最酷炫的操作，最好看的脸。

周珈蓝不追星，穷到经常要担心下顿饭吃什么，她也很难有追星的闲心，但她很关注周泽楷。

就像那句话说的，阴沟里的老鼠总忍不住悄悄窥伺太阳底下光辉明亮的漂亮人类，周珈蓝忍不住窥伺周泽楷的动向，尽管时时会被他的光芒灼伤眼睛。

非要找更多的理由，血缘或许可以拿来当做借口。

从亲戚谱系上来讲，周珈蓝应该管周泽楷叫一声表哥……但从来没有叫过，没有这种场合。

她妈妈当年任性地一见钟情，从S城追着那个男人去到偏僻的边境小城，炽热的爱情最终换来被残忍抛弃。

周珈蓝从小跟着妈妈长大，随母姓，她还记得妈妈的脸，但已经很模糊了。

初中某一天放学之后，她回家看见妈妈躺在地板上，被酗酒和病痛常年折磨的脸孔消瘦，后脑勺凝固着一团小小的血迹。

那是她最后一次见到妈妈。

之后她一个人生活，趴在盥洗室里呕到吐血时想到小时候妈妈喝醉酒之后说，珈蓝你有一个哥哥，他叫……

打住，周珈蓝不再想下去。

她没有认亲的想法，更从来没想过会靠近周泽楷。

尽管长大之后她每天都看见他的广告、硬照、采访新闻，在现实中反复遇见他的粉丝、他的周边、他代言的产品。

偶然会生出一种大家都很近的错觉……周珈蓝很明白两个人相隔天堑，不如不见。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The stomach bag seemed to be clenched into a ball, and the internal organs were turbulent.

"Ugh... ugh!"

There were painful vomiting sounds, the bathroom was small and old, peeling wall coverings were piled in the corner, and the faucet was turned on.

The sound of water rushed, and a slender and pale face was reflected in the broken mirror.

Her long, snow-white curly hair reaches her waist, her eyelashes are also snow-white, like fine snow, and her eyes are an extremely light purple, almost like pink.

She looked miserable, wearing an old green dress, her brows were wrinkled together in pain, she had been tortured by illness for a long time, her face was pale and haggard, but she was so beautiful.

Like a butterfly thrown into this world by the hand of the God of Beauty.

Time stops flowing here and solidifies into amber, holding your breath for this peerless beauty.

The girl in the mirror smiled and raised the corners of her mouth.

Time starts flowing again.

Zhou Jialan dipped her hands in water, washed her face first, and then hurriedly combed her long white hair.

The lines of her fingers were as slender as petals, and the color of the blood vessels could be seen clearly through the thin skin, like the meridians wrapped around the petals.

Zhou Zekai's latest endorsement advertisement is playing on the big screen outside the window. The young boy has a beautiful and impeccable face. He is tall and thin, with sharp and beautiful side lines. He has a good look that girls nowadays are willing to scream for.

Zhou Jialan knows him. Living in this era, it is difficult for you not to know Zhou Zekai. This name is simply an adjective of popularity and commercial value.

The top professional player of National Game Glory, the most popular GPL all-star player in the most popular professional game, the club is S City Samsara, the profession is sharpshooter, the account card is Cloud Piercer, the weapons are Wildfire and Shattering Frost...the coolest operation, the most beautiful face.

Zhou Jialan is not star-chasing. She is so poor that she often has to worry about what to eat next. It is difficult for her to have the leisure to chase stars, but she pays close attention to Zhou Zekai.

As the saying goes, rats in the gutter can't help but secretly spy on beautiful humans who shine brightly under the sun. Zhou Jialan can't help but spy on Zhou Zekai's movements, even though his eyes will always be burned by his light.

If you have to find more reasons, blood might be used as an excuse.

From the perspective of family genealogy, Zhou Jialan should call Zhou Zekai his cousin... but he has never called him cousin. There is no such occasion.

Her mother fell in love at first sight willfully and chased the man from S city to a remote border town. Her passionate love was eventually cruelly abandoned.

Zhou Jialan grew up with her mother and took her mother's surname. She still remembered her mother's face, but it was very blurry.

One day after school in junior high school, she came home and saw her mother lying on the floor, her face emaciated by alcoholism and illness, and a small blood stain on the back of her head.

That was the last time she saw her mother.

After that, she lived alone. When she lay in the bathroom and vomited blood, she thought of her mother who was drunk when she was a child and said, Jialan, you have a brother, his name is...

Stop, Zhou Jialan stopped thinking about it.

She had no intention of acknowledging her relationship, and she never thought of getting close to Zhou Zekai.

Although when she grew up, she saw his advertisements, photos, and news interviews every day, and repeatedly met his fans, his merchandise, and the products he endorsed in reality.

Occasionally, there will be an illusion that everyone is very close... Zhou Jialan understands very well that two people are separated by a huge chasm, so it is better not to see each other.
